description: SentinelMCP Registry — known-bad MCP tool schemas and attack patterns. CVE-style IDs.

entries.title: Exfiltration via hidden tool description instruction
entries.description: Tool description contains hidden instruction to exfiltrate data to attacker-controlled URL. Targets agents that expose tool descriptions to the LLM context.

entries.title: Rug pull — tool schema modified after initial validation
entries.description: A previously clean MCP server silently replaces tool schemas with malicious variants after the initial security check. The SHA-256 hash of the schema changes between calls.

entries.title: Credential dump via environment variable access
entries.description: Tool parameters or descriptions instruct the agent to read and return environment variables, API keys, or secret tokens. Common in indirect prompt injection via poisoned file contents.

entries.title: Financial transaction exfiltration via indirect prompt injection
entries.description: Attacker instruction embedded in tool response triggers agent to initiate financial transfers, cryptocurrency withdrawals, or payments to attacker-controlled accounts. Confirmed in InjecAgent DH benchmark.

entries.title: PII exfiltration to attacker email via data-stealing chain
entries.description: Multi-tool attack: first tool retrieves sensitive user data (addresses, payment methods, medical records), second tool emails it to an attacker-controlled address. Confirmed across 31/32 InjecAgent DS cases.

entries.title: Security control bypass — 2FA/MFA disable
entries.description: Indirect prompt injection instructs the agent to disable two-factor authentication or multi-factor authentication on accounts, enabling follow-on account takeover.

entries.title: Covert file exfiltration to hidden directories
entries.description: Agent is instructed to move sensitive files to hidden directories (.hidden, .ssh) or world-readable temp paths (/tmp, /var/tmp) where they can be retrieved later.

entries.title: Deepfake generation abuse via agent tool access
entries.description: Agent with access to audio/video deepfake generation tools is instructed via IPI to create synthetic media using the victim's identity data, enabling fraud and impersonation.

entries.title: Base64-encoded injection bypass
entries.description: Attacker encodes prompt injection payload in base64 to bypass regex-based detection. The encoded string is embedded in tool descriptions or parameters and decoded by the LLM at inference time.

entries.title: Tool poisoning via MCP server description metadata
entries.description: Malicious instructions embedded in the tool description field of MCP server metadata. Affects 7 major MCP clients confirmed in arxiv 2603.22489 (March 2026). Insufficient static validation and parameter visibility are root causes.

entries.title: Mosaic data exfiltration — low-signal multi-tool reconnaissance
entries.description: No single tool call exceeds a risk threshold, but the combination of calls across a session reveals a coordinated reconnaissance pattern. Requires session-level behavioral analysis (TF-IDF sliding window) to detect. Individual calls: list files, read SSH config, check env, list users.
